description: Placed order (COD) of one simple in-stock product for a user the test created, on the store, so it shows in that user's and its sales rep's order lists. The user needs ADDRESS_OF_USER first. Deleted at teardown. Test Z10-TC-31722.

store.description: Store code the order is placed on (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the user who places the order: link it to a created user of the test (@user.userId)
